name: favourite-parks-on-cmd-w-and-comes-back
description:
Cmd+W on a favourite still showing its own page parks the page instead of deleting it, and the next tile click shows that same page with no load.

The browser tests drive the sidebar's own close route. This one drives the real gesture: Cmd+W reaches ExecuteCommand in atrium_native_widget_mac.mm, which is a different entry point into ParkFavoriteTab and the only one a user actually presses. A seam that works from the test route and not from the keystroke would pass every browser test and ship broken.

The two log lines carry the tab id, so a restore that quietly opened a fresh tab reads as a different number and the ordering assertion fails.
